title: docs(spec): register the user-field deleteBehavior enforcement as an ADR-0087 semantic entry and correct the delete-walk prose (#29415)
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86kXbU7ZTrsHb3vcyhV8cP6)_
Fixes #29415

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：为 #29368（user 字段上声明的 deleteBehavior 在删除用户时生效）补上 ADR-0087 语义迁移条目 `user-field-delete-behavior-enforced`；修正 spec 里仍说「user 字段从不参与删除联动」的文字；字段设计器与对象表单在 user 字段上也显示 deleteBehavior 控件。
- 为什么改：#29368 的契约复核 6579523704 的两条 should-fix（A：迁移条目；B：过时的 spec 文字）。没有条目，`objectstack migrate meta` 和升级指南都看不到这次行为变化；Studio 也无法在 user 字段上编写这个键。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字、迁移条目和表单可见性规则，运行时不变、作者可写的键不变。#29253 的 changeset（未发布）同步改为 `registered`，因此 `check-empty-changeset` 按设计保持红灯，需要你在本 PR 上确认这次更正。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.user-field-delete-behavior-enforced.ts；.changeset/29253-user-field-delete-behavior.md；packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts（visibleWhen）。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/form-delete-behavior-options.test.ts，预期 18 条全绿（其中 2 条是新增的 user 用例）。
- 需要你做的：在本 PR 上确认对 #29253 未发布 changeset 的这次更正（check-empty-changeset 的人工确认路径）。

## What changes

**A. ADR-0087 semantic entry** (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.user-field-delete-behavior-enforced.ts`, id `user-field-delete-behavior-enforced`). PR #29368 made a declared `deleteBehavior` on a `user` field take effect when the user is deleted. No key moved, so there is no conversion; the entry records the judgment the consumer owes, following the two 18.x precedents `field-master-detail-set-null-refused` and `user-field-foreign-reference-refused`:

- surface: `object.fields[].deleteBehavior` (and `objectExtension.fields[].deleteBehavior`) on a `type: 'user'` field;
- replacement: declare only the outcome you want enforced, or drop the key to keep the field out of the walk;
- reason: the declaration was inert and now takes effect; the stored population of objects saved while the parse still wrote `set_null` on every type can carry a `set_null` nobody authored. On a non-required field that is accepted as it is (it clears the field, as on a `lookup`); on a `required` field it now refuses the user delete with 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` wherever clearing would leave the field empty;
- acceptance: every declared value is meant, a `required` field carries `set_null` only where the refusal is intended, and a test delete gives the declared outcome per field.

The entry reaches the generated registry (one hit for the id in the gitignored `registry.ts`), and `check:spec-changes` / `check:upgrade-guide` project it in memory.

**The #29253 changeset** (`.changeset/29253-user-field-delete-behavior.md`, unreleased; added to the claim by amendment 6584095382). Finding A of contract review 6579523704: its ADR-0087 marker goes from `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` to `registered user-field-delete-behavior-enforced`, and its "Rows stored before #9784" paragraph now names the entry and the fix. The marker's old "there is no stored value for a conversion to rewrite" clause, which contradicted that paragraph, is gone with it.

**B. Spec prose that said a `user` field never joins the delete walk:**

- `data/field.zod.ts`: the `deleteBehavior` docblock (#9784 paragraph), the `.overwrite` comment, the comment above the `user` reference refusal, and the refusal message itself ("a `user` field never did" becomes "a `user` field has no default and keeps the id unless it declares one");
- the D3 entry `user-field-foreign-reference-refused`: "which a `user` field never did" becomes "which a `user` field that declares no `deleteBehavior` does not do";
- `data/hook.zod.ts`: the `referentialFieldClear` docblock and describe, and the `referentialCascadeDelete` docblock, now name `user` beside `lookup` / `tree`; `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx` is regenerated for the describe (`gen:docs`);
- `contracts/objectql-engine.ts`: the `getCascadeDeleteObjects` docblock names `user`.

⛔ **Held, owed after the freeze:** `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, the two `cascadeDeleteObjects` describes (`GetMetaItemResponseSchema` and `GetMetaItemCachedResponseSchema`'s sibling text, which enumerate `master_detail` / `lookup` / `tree`). protocol.ts is frozen until 2026-11-03 06:00Z at the latest; the seat sends that edit after the freeze lifts.

**Forms.** `data/field.form.ts` and `data/object.form.ts` showed `deleteBehavior` only for `lookup` and `master_detail`. The `lookup` branch now reads `data.type in ['lookup','user']` in both files, so a Studio author can set the key on a `user` field with all three outcomes. A `user` field has no default, and the metadata-admin select prefills nothing, so the control writes a value only when the author picks one.

## Why

Contract review 6579523704 on PR #29368, should-fixes A and B; triage 6583845201 grades it p1 because both ship with 18.3.0.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/data/form-delete-behavior-options.test.ts` gains two cases per form: a `user` author sees exactly one control offering all three values, and a `text` author sees none.

- Reverse verification, on commit `44bec0e9`: with both `visibleWhen` rules put back to `data.type == 'lookup'` (zero hits of the new spelling on disk after the swap), the suite reported `2 failed | 16 passed (18)`, the two `user` cases, one per form; restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under the verify lock: Test Files 792 passed (792), Tests 23526 passed and 1 todo; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (VERDICT command-exit 0), then `check:generated`: one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`, from the hook describe), regenerated with `gen:docs`, then all 14 up to date.
- `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide`: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 106 commands): run from a runner that records `CMD :: exit N`, measured on head `21cd9672`, and reconciled with `--ran`: 106 derived, 105 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (`dispatch-gates --ran` exit 0). Of the 105, 104 exit 0 and one exits 1: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, by design (see Acceptance notes). Two first runs exited 3 (prerequisite) and were re-run after the prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit (then exit 0, 48 cases), and `check:i18n` after building its extract closure (then exit 0, 10 packages in sync). NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, it needs every package built); CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- `check-empty-changeset` stays red by design: this PR rewrites a pending release note it did not add (the #29253 changeset). That is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class; its remedy is a confirmation on the PR, not a restore. The rewrite is the one the contract review asked for and the seat's claim amendment 6584095382 adds to this card's surface.
- Not in scope, noted: the `deleteBehavior` control in both forms is still hidden for `tree`, whose parse materializes `set_null` and which the walk reads. Nothing in this card asks for it.
- Not in scope, noted: the metadata-admin select has no empty option, so the form can set a `user` field's `deleteBehavior` but cannot clear a stored one; clearing stays a Source-tab edit.
- Skills-docs follow-up for the enforcement itself is #29400 (open).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally: it is CI's run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
